title: Distance and rejection probability
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $w:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The smaller of the fractions of coordinates where $w$ is false and where it is true is at most the probability that the tester, which samples two coordinates independently and uniformly and accepts exactly when their values agree, rejects $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
